mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_srm_packing_list (asn_id, asn_line_id, parts_no, pn_no, description, packing_method, shipped_qty, units_per_pallet, layers, pallet_count, total_units, gross_weight_per, net_weight_per, total_gross_weight, total_net_weight, pallet_length, pallet_width, pallet_height, total_cbm, carton_count, total_gross_carton, total_net_carton, carton_cbm, carton_size, remark, status) VALUES (#{asnId}, #{asnLineId}, #{partsNo}, #{pnNo}, #{description}, #{packingMethod}, #{shippedQty}, #{unitsPerPallet}, #{layers}, #{palletCount}, #{totalUnits}, #{grossWeightPer}, #{netWeightPer}, #{totalGrossWeight}, #{totalNetWeight}, #{palletLength}, #{palletWidth}, #{palletHeight}, #{totalCbm}, #{cartonCount}, #{totalGrossCarton}, #{totalNetCarton}, #{cartonCbm}, #{cartonSize}, #{remark}, 'CREATED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_srm_packing_list WHERE asn_id = #{asnId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_srm_packing_list WHERE asn_line_id = #{asnLineId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_srm_handling_unit (packing_list_id, asn_id, unit_type, unit_no, unit_seq, quantity, gross_weight, net_weight, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm, cbm, print_status) VALUES (#{packingListId}, #{asnId}, #{unitType}, #{unitNo}, #{unitSeq}, #{quantity}, #{grossWeight}, #{netWeight}, #{lengthMm}, #{widthMm}, #{heightMm}, #{cbm}, 'UNPRINTED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_srm_handling_unit WHERE packing_list_id = #{packingListId} ORDER BY unit_seq ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_srm_handling_unit WHERE asn_id = #{asnId} ORDER BY packing_list_id, unit_seq ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_srm_handling_unit WHERE packing_list_id = #{packingListId}
